Air purifier sales surge as demand, smart features drive market growth | Photo Credit: Haider Ali Khan
Demand for air purifiers in India has witnessed explosive growth in 2026, with major brands and retail platforms reporting sales doubling or tripling year-on-year. Driven by an early surge ahead of the traditional winter pollution season , consumer behaviour is shifting toward viewing indoor air quality as a year-round health priority rather than an emergency seasonal purchase.
According to industry leaders, adoption is gaining momentum well before peak pollution months.
Smart tech brand Qubo recorded a 150 percent growth over the previous year, while Xiaomi registered approximately 3X year-on-year sales growth during the festive period. Industry executives note that growing awareness surrounding indoor pollutants, ranging from dust and pet dander to everyday cooking and cleaning emissions, is encouraging households to take a proactive approach to home wellness throughout the year.
Retail footprint and online traffic reflect this expanding market footprint across the country. Electronics retailer Croma reported that air purifier sales volumes have more than doubled in 2026. While Delhi-NCR remains the dominant market, cities like Mumbai and regions beyond traditional high-pollution belts are showing sustained upticks.
Premium tech maker Dyson also reported that visits to its air purifier pages grew by over 100 percent in October compared to the same period last year.
Modern buyers are increasingly seeking advanced functionality and intelligent filtration tech. Croma highlighted strong consumer interest in models featuring real-time AQI displays, app controls, and multi-functional units combining purification with humidification or heating.
On e-commerce platforms, Amazon India reported that sales doubled over the past week. Shoppers are actively leveraging Rufus, Amazon’s personalised AI shopping assistant, to filter models by room size, filter type, and live sensor capabilities, prompting the e-retailer to expand selection on Amazon Now for immediate delivery.
“We have observed a notable increase in consumer demand for air purifiers on Flipkart, reflected in higher search activity, product discovery and purchases. Northern India continues to account for a significant share of demand for the category. We also witnessed a rise in purchases during the early hours following Diwali, coinciding with heightened concerns around deteriorating air quality and the steps households are taking to manage their indoor environments,” said Flipkart.
